entities.name: River Toloron
entities.description: A river in south-western Jamuraa on Dominaria that flows south from the Blue Mountains into the Bay of Pearls.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: A continent of Dominaria in whose south-west the River Toloron lies.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which the River Toloron flows.

entities.name: Western Wastes
entities.description: A region divided from the Sukurvian Desert by the Toloron.

entities.name: Sukurvian Desert
entities.description: A desert on the other bank of the Toloron from the Western Wastes.

entities.name: Blue Mountains
entities.description: The mountains where the Toloron has its source.

entities.name: Tirras
entities.description: A city-state the Toloron flows past; riverboats can travel up to and beyond it.

entities.name: Palmyra
entities.description: A city-state the Toloron flows past.

entities.name: Bryce
entities.description: A city-state built on a delta where the Toloron splits into many branches, connected by bridges.

entities.name: Bay of Pearls
entities.description: The bay the Toloron flows into.

entities.name: Sea of Serenity
entities.description: A sea the Toloron flows into.

entities.name: Sunken Sea
entities.description: A sea beneath Sukurvia that the Toloron connects into.

relations.note: The river lies in south-western Jamuraa.
relations.quote: The River Toloron is a river in south-western Jamuraa on Dominaria
